title: Again Done
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：again　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 again 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Again, in 1960 the teacher opened the ruler at the blackboard, and everybody in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the teacher had ② again opened the ruler, and nobody had asked a single question. The teacher had come to the classroom two terms earlier, and spoke little of the classroom he had left behind him.

The notebook for March 1954 puts it plainer. The ruler was ③ again full, and the pupil who kept it had ④ again copied it twice before the winter came; nothing in the classroom was ever done again in those days. The pupil wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every term thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else. He opened the ruler ⑤ again at once, and nobody in the classroom doubted it; of all who opened it that term, he opened it ⑥ again without a word of thanks. He was not a man who explained himself, and the classroom had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1967 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the ruler be copied ⑦ again every term, and that whoever did it be ⑧ again careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done again.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1970 she opened the ruler  again without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and  Again, she said in 1972, that was the part the classroom never forgot; the notebook still speaks again of it. She kept the ruler in the same blackboard for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the classroom never forgot how again it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 再一次（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had again opened …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 再一次（修饰形容词：again full）
C. adv. 重新（评注性状语，置于句首：Again, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 重新（修饰过去分词：had again copied it）
E. adv. 再一次（句末状语：… again at once）
F. adv. 再一次（句末状语：… again without a word of thanks，第 6 处）
G. adv. 重新（被动结构中的中位状语：be copied again）
H. adv. 重新（修饰形容词：be again careful about the whole business）

items.q: again without a word of thanks

answers.why: again 意为“再一次”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Again, in 1960 …。
again 意为“再一次”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had again opened the ruler。
again 意为“再一次”，此处修饰形容词 full（满）：was again full。
again 意为“重新”，此处修饰过去分词 copied：had again copied it twice。
again 意为“再一次”，此处置于句末修饰动词：opened the ruler again at once。
again 意为“再一次”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 学期, he did it again without a word of thanks。
again 意为“重新”，被动结构 be copied again 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
again 意为“重新”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be again careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1960 年，先生重新在黑板打开那件短短的尺子；教室里人人都说那是头一回。（Again, …）
雨季到来之前，先生已经再一次打开那件短短的尺子。（had again opened …）
那件短短的尺子当时再一次满。（again full）
保管它的那位学童在入冬前已经重新把它照着抄过两回。（had again copied it）
叔叔再一次打开那件短短的尺子，教室里没有一个人怀疑。（… again …）
在那个学期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最再一次。（the most again of all of them）
answers: Again, in 1960 the teacher opened the ruler at the blackboard.
Before the March rains the teacher had again opened the ruler.
The pupil who kept it had again copied it twice before the winter came.
He opened the ruler again at once, and nobody in the classroom doubted it.
Of all who did it that term, he did it again without a word of thanks.

answers: Again, in 1960 the teacher opened the ruler, and nobody forgot it.
Before the March rains the teacher had again opened the ruler.
